run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time graph composition forward and backward passes
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward score benchmark to time forward scoring on batches of graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for execution of Python functions
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function that benchmarks gtn.compose and gtn.backward on batches of linear graphs
review_time_forward_score: review the time_forward_score function that benchmarks gtn.forward_score and gtn.backward on batches of graphs
